description: Disposable Hyper-V test VMs from a pool, Windows or Linux (Debian, Ubuntu): several agents at once, from a clean or shared checkpoint or kept warm; lease checkpoints; session 0, desktop or SSH runs.

apps: Its helper service, set up once in an admin PowerShell (setup\install.ps1), and again after upgrading
A Windows 11 x64 ISO for the pool's VMs: Microsoft's Enterprise evaluation, or your own non-evaluation copy (Enterprise, Pro or Education) with its product key
For Linux guests only: Windows' OpenSSH Client (an optional feature); the helper downloads and verifies the pinned Debian and Ubuntu cloud images itself
